row.answer: Trundle is a fighter/tank who pressures enemies with empowered basic attacks and an area that boosts his attack speed, movement speed and healing. His attacks emphasize physical damage and AD, while his ultimate drains health through magic damage and steals resistances.
row.counterplay: Draw him away from his domain and avoid prolonged trades while your resistances are reduced.
